hypothesis: Within a participant and programmed heat level, the rating change between temperature-matched repeats is associated with the change in local C3/C4 alpha power after adjustment for measured temperature and the level-specific repeat contrast.

expected_structure.structural_failure_policy: Require the pilot's channel, reference, timing and marker structure. Exclude a structurally invalid run and report the reason. Reject seconds with invalid ratings or temperature or stimulus inconsistent with expected level. Report rating-log alignment separately; embedded rating on the EEG clock is the primary measure.

screen.nomination: Count failed one-second scalp checks in calibration windows. Rank positive counts descending and break ties alphabetically. Protect C3, Cz, C4 and all eight local-reference neighbors.
screen.eog_filter: Third-order Butterworth bandpass applied forward and backward to event seconds 12–38; assess seconds 25–35 in the buffered copy.
screen.matching: Same participant, programmed level and relative one-second interval. Compare all pairs of repeats in chronological direction. Use the median of per-second median ratings and temperatures over the matched seconds.

alpha.method: Subtract each local neighbor mean from its center; use one-second constant-detrended Hann periodograms. Sum 1 Hz bins, take the natural log per site, and average over sites and common seconds.
alpha.effect: Later-minus-earlier log alpha per 10 released rating units, also as percent alpha change via 100*expm1.

inference.model: Weighted least squares of later-minus-earlier log alpha on rating difference per 10 units and measured temperature difference, with categorical programmed level x repeat contrast. Participant weight is divided equally over their retained pairs.
inference.test: Two-sided centered participant cluster bootstrap. Resample whole participants with replacement, preserving their pairs. Use the basic 95% interval from centered errors and the doubled smaller tail with a +1 correction. Report the number of valid draws.
sensitivity: primary threshold plus later-minus-earlier slow EOG swing covariate
inference.pass_counts: Report downloaded, structurally valid, at least one block with five accepted seconds, and at least one matched block pair. Only the last group contributes to the primary model.
